sections.dosage_and_administration: wash the affected areamay soak the wart in warm water for 5minutes o dry area thoroughly o usingthe applicator(brush or cotton swab), applyone drop at a time to sufficiently cover eachwart e allow it to fully absorb and let dryrepeat this procedure once or twicedaily as needed (until the wart is removed)for up to 12 weeks
